user.title: Add an Astrion remote
user.description: The remote's address on your network. Its configuration server runs on port 8080 — the same address the Settings panel on the remote shows.

error.cannot_connect: Nothing answered on that address. Check the remote is awake and on the same network, and that the configuration server is enabled in its Settings panel.
error.no_webhook_endpoint: The remote answered, but does not accept a webhook id. Update Astrion Custom Dashboard on the remote to a build that includes POST /webhook-id, then try again.

abort.already_configured: That remote is already set up.

init.title: Update source
init.description: GitHub repository the update entity compares the installed version against. Change it if you run a fork that publishes its own releases.

push_dashboard.name: Push dashboard
push_dashboard.description: Replaces dashboard.json on the remote and reloads its dashboard live.

path.name: File path
path.description: A dashboard.json readable by Home Assistant. The directory must be in allowlist_external_dirs.

config.name: Inline config
config.description: The dashboard config itself, instead of a file.

ring.name: Ring
ring.description: Plays a sound on the remote so it can be found.

sound.name: Sound
sound.description: Which of the device's own sounds to loop.
